judgments.reason: The model never asserts that the three-coin commission is applied before payment or that bids above available coins can win; its arithmetic uses the commission to compute net value but does not claim it changes payment ordering or allows overbidding, and the rule text explicitly requires bids ≤ your coins.

The model treats rival bids as sealed/private (e.g. describes sealed bids and waiting as preserving privacy) and does not state that waiting reveals committed rival bid values before committing, so no mechanism of precommit revelation is articulated or demonstrated.

The transcript shows settlement after all three lots were sold (normal behavior). The model does not claim or demonstrate early settlement with unauctioned lots, so no discrepancy or mechanism is identified.

The model explicitly notes catalog items are not auction wins and never claims the three-coin commission applies to catalog purchases; it applies commission only when describing auction win accounting, so the proposed substitution is not articulated or shown.
